svg.title: Agenti customer banking and reconciliation business workflow
svg.desc: Role-based process with expected inputs and outcomes, independent next-day opening, correction loop, customer cases, and a clearly marked proposed MCP extension.

text.tspan: Agenti: Customer Banking and End-of-Day Reconciliation
Business workflow | Input (In) and output (Out) at each step | Web and Android
Baseline: PR #94, bf4abf7. Describes behavior after release/activation; not proof of production deployment.
A1-A3 RELEASE GATE: verified real-bank importer + account/wallet binding + Admin activation.
Currently gated: real-bank samples/profile verification. One active teller and one enrolled bank account per branch.
In: business date; explanation as needed
Out: saved count and approval request
No trading until opening is approved
Use actual time, amount and references
In: actual balances and observation times
Explain each variance; review the register
No external bank transfer is initiated
Correct extraction with reason if needed
Out: committed bank evidence, not approval
Yesterday's approval may still be pending
Old trading must already be closed
Next-day operations do not wait for
Match unique exact entries; inspect gaps
Check all wallets and overnight coverage
Out: eligible result or explicit blockers
Out: linked new history; notify Admin
Do not edit count or reopen old trading
Notify teller; no money moves again
R7 IF LATER EVIDENCE CHANGES FACTS
In: accepted new source or correction
Retain prior counts and approval history
Admin returns to R4-R6 for new review
A matching grand total alone is not enough
Corrections resubmitted -> refresh evidence and re-review R4
Exception sub-process: bank resolution and customer settlement are separate
Refund: verified available bank credit AND customer cash still held. Retry: do not receive the same cash twice.
If bank evidence is late, closing approval stays pending or carries a valid verified exception; N1 can still proceed.
M1-M3 OPTIONAL MCP EXTENSION - PROPOSED, NOT IMPLEMENTED
Authorized user asks a question -> read-only tools return scoped facts -> AI explains -> human acts in Agenti.
No approval, wallet write or production access is implied. The core banking workflow does not depend on MCP.
